## What changes, and why

## How I tested it

- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .` and `uv run mypy` are clean
- [ ] A behavior change has a test and a line in the docs
- [ ] A change to `torpor/protocol.py` follows the procedure in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] No real host names, MACs, monitor serials, pairing codes or keys in tests or docs
